tools.name: search_domains
tools.description: Live availability + yearly price (renewal same). Letters are never changed for you: a name with accents, www., a subdomain or other characters is refused with a suggestion; only spaces and capitals are dropped, and the checked name comes back as name. status: available | taken | premium_not_offered

tools.name: get_prices
tools.description: USD per year for every extension; next = announced price change; restore_usd = fee to restore an expired domain.

tools.name: sign_in
tools.description: Sign in or create an account. Call with email → user gets a 6-digit code by email; call again with email+code → signed in (API key).

tools.name: account
tools.description: Get the account (owner details, saved card, limits). Pass fields to set the domain owner (registrant) details; needed before the first order.

tools.name: setup_card
tools.description: Returns setup_url where the owner saves a card once, with a monthly limit; orders are then paid automatically within it. A lower limit for a saved card applies at once.

tools.name: create_order
tools.description: Register 1–10 available domains for the owner. Pays with the saved card (then waits for the registry) or returns payment_url for the owner.

tools.name: get_order
tools.description: Order status, payment confirmation (paid_at, receipt_url). Use wait=25 instead of polling.

tools.name: list_domains
tools.description: Domains in the account with expiry dates.

tools.name: set_nameservers
tools.description: Point a domain to 2–4 nameservers. Owner is emailed.

tools.name: renew_domain
tools.description: Renew a domain; paid like create_order.
